text: fishtraitR R package access imputed values (predictive uncertainty) life-history parameters. used Stage-3 “fish-trait-network,” (Thorson Lindmark, n.d.) defines three stages: Compilation, .e., accessing harmonizing life-history measurements records can used estimate (e.g., stock-recruitment records); Imputation, e.g., applying phylogenetic trait imputation using phylogenetic structural equation models (Thorson Bijl 2023) share information among taxa traits; Distribution, e.g., tracking requests future updates, identifying updating API access values, discussing best practices user communities. stages can done intensively infrequently Benchmark analysis, routinely Update analysis, fishtraitR uses Zenodo source values intended updated.

text: , show fishtraitR used. first download select species download traits, plot output single traits, pairs traits   can also use predicted traits calculate plug-estimates derived quantities intrinsic growth rate steepness stock-recruit curve: Finally, can use samples multivariate-normal approximation predictive distribution approximate uncertainty derived quantities
code: library("fishtraitR")  # Download database from Zenodo download_traits() #> [1] "C:\\Users\\jtuth\\AppData\\Local/R/cache/R/ftn-distribution/zenodo_24259333" # Download trait values and predictive distribution traits = get_traits( c("Gadus morhua", "Gadus chalcogrammus") )  # Plot single traits plot( traits, variables = "phi" ) # Plot pair of traits plot( traits, variables = c("log(natural_mortality)", "log(growth_coefficient)") ) # Extract growth rate derived = get_r(   K = exp(traits$est['log(growth_coefficient)',"Gadus morhua"]),   Winf = exp(traits$est['log(weight_infinity)',"Gadus morhua"]),   a_mat = exp(traits$est['log(age_maturity)',"Gadus morhua"]),   CR = 1 + exp(traits$est['phi',"Gadus morhua"]),   M = exp(traits$est['log(natural_mortality)',"Gadus morhua"]) ) derived #> intrinsic_growth_rate       generation_time           steepness_h  #>             0.3416850            13.1518847             0.8901644 # Sample from predictive distribution traits_i = mvtnorm::rmvnorm(   n = 250,   mean = traits$est[,"Gadus morhua"],   sigma = traits$cov[,,"Gadus morhua"] )  # Calculate and plot pred_zi = mapply(   FUN = get_r,   K = exp(traits_i[,'log(growth_coefficient)']),   Winf = exp(traits_i[,'log(growth_coefficient)']),   a_mat = exp(traits_i[,'log(age_maturity)']),   CR = 1 + exp(traits_i[,'phi']),   M = exp(traits_i[,'log(natural_mortality)']) ) # Intrinsic growth rate hist(pred_zi['intrinsic_growth_rate',], main = "intrinsic growth rate", xlab = "r (per year)") # Steepness hist(pred_zi['steepness_h',], main = "steepness", xlab = "h") # Generation time hist(pred_zi['generation_time',], main = "Generation length", xlab = "G (years)")

code: # Get traits for selected species download_traits() #> [1] "C:\\Users\\jtuth\\AppData\\Local/R/cache/R/ftn-distribution/zenodo_24259333" traits = get_traits( "Lutjanus campechanus" )  # Extract growth rate get_r(   K = exp(traits$est['log(growth_coefficient)']),   Winf = exp(traits$est['log(growth_coefficient)']),   a_mat = exp(traits$est['log(age_maturity)']),   CR = 1 + exp(traits$est['phi']),   M = exp(traits$est['log(natural_mortality)']) ) #> Error in eigen(LeslieM_numbers, only.values = TRUE): infinite or missing values in 'x'  # Sample from predictive distribution traits_i = mvtnorm::rmvnorm(   n = 250,   mean = traits$est,   sigma = traits$cov ) #> Error in UseMethod("isSymmetric"): no applicable method for 'isSymmetric' applied to an object of class "c('array', 'double', 'numeric')"  # Calculate and plot pred_zi = mapply(   FUN = get_r,   K = exp(traits_i[,'log(growth_coefficient)']),   Winf = exp(traits_i[,'log(growth_coefficient)']),   a_mat = exp(traits_i[,'log(age_maturity)']),   CR = 1 + exp(traits_i[,'phi']),   M = exp(traits_i[,'log(natural_mortality)']) ) #> Error: object 'traits_i' not found hist(pred_zi['intrinsic_growth_rate',]) #> Error: object 'pred_zi' not found
